title: Solar Plant Monitoring Software | EnerMAN Technologies
description: Solar plant monitoring software and hardware: ETi-SOL cloud SCADA, ETi-EDGE local SCADA, ETi-PPC, ETi-LOG, ETi-LMS, ETi-ZES and ETi-CAST.
heading: IoT SCADA and RMS products for solar plants

blocks.text: IoT SCADA and RMS products for solar plants
EnerMAN builds IoT SCADA and energy management products for the renewable energy industry: hardware, firmware, cloud platform and mobile apps, all made in-house in Bengaluru.
From the panel in the field to one screen
EnerMAN’s IoT SCADA panel is the field unit of the platform. It collects plant data, keeps logging through network outages, and sends the data to ETi-SOL in the cloud or ETi-EDGE on your own server.
Weatherproof enclosure with robust protection for field deployments.
Supports RS-485, Ethernet, 4G/LTE, Wi-Fi and Modbus.
Instant communication with cloud SCADA via IoT gateway.
Stores critical performance data even during network downtime.
Built-in encryption and remote firmware upgrades.
Cloud and local SCADA, power plant control, data logging, load management and DG synchronisation, zero export and generation forecasting.
Cloud IoT SCADA to monitor, control and analyse your solar PV assets remotely, in real time.
Edge SCADA that monitors, controls and analyses your plants from your own server.
IoT datalogger that collects real-time plant data and pushes it to the cloud or a local server.
Power plant controller for active power, reactive power, power factor and ramp rate at plant, block and inverter level.
Zero export control at the edge, so no solar power reaches the grid.
Load management with DG sync: adjusts solar output to live load, grid and diesel generator status.
Forecasts solar plant generation from weather data: day-ahead, week-ahead and intra-day reports.
In the cloud or on your own server
